findings.anchor: query = f"SELECT id, status, total FROM orders WHERE customer_id = '{owner_id}'"
findings.body: The `owner_id` parameter is directly interpolated into the SQL query string without sanitization or parameterization, enabling SQL injection attacks.
findings.failure_scenario: When an attacker controls the `owner_id` parameter, they can inject arbitrary SQL commands into the query, potentially allowing data exfiltration, modification, or bypass of authorization checks.
findings.title: Construct SQL query with untrusted input

findings.anchor: def register_shipment_events(event_type: str, events: list[str] = []) -> dict[str, list[str]]:
findings.body: The `events` parameter uses a mutable list as a default value, which is shared across all function calls. This can lead to unexpected state mutations.
findings.failure_scenario: When multiple calls to `register_shipment_events` are made without providing the `events` argument, the default list is shared across all calls, causing previously recorded events to be lost or modified unexpectedly.
findings.title: Use mutable default argument for list

findings.anchor: def newest_queue_id(records: list[dict[str, object]]) -> str | None:
findings.body: The docstring states that `newest_queue_id` returns the newest identifier in constant time, but the function uses `sorted()`, which is O(n log n).
findings.failure_scenario: When a developer relies on the claim that `newest_queue_id` runs in constant time, they may implement inefficient algorithms elsewhere, leading to performance issues.
findings.title: Docstring claims constant-time execution

findings.anchor: def flag_large_backorder_totals(rows: list[dict[str, object]], threshold: float) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
findings.body: The `threshold` parameter is defined but never used; the function always checks against the hardcoded value 5000.
findings.failure_scenario: When a caller passes a `threshold` value, it is ignored, which may lead to unexpected behavior if the threshold is intended to be configurable.
findings.title: Unused function parameter
